description: Maps mark-refresh quality status into paper-only execution sizing and risk-state overlay actions.
required_behavior: Keep the M139 fallback and M137 preflight checks intact.
When mark-refresh quality status is pass, run normal paper entry sizing.
When mark-refresh quality status is warn, overlay the paper portfolio risk state as monitor and apply the configured monitor_size_multiplier to new paper entries.
When mark-refresh quality status is block, block new paper entries or skip execution through the existing mark-refresh gate.
Record the selected quality action and effective monitor size multiplier in tick, runner, daemon, Markdown, and JSON outputs.
Affect paper sizing/risk-state only; never submit, stage, transmit, or mutate real broker positions.
